newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse ends flat, investors wary.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse ends flat, investors wary.

text.p: 1435 GMT - The blue-chip Bel-20 index .BFX closed barely changed on Wednesday as investors remained cautious, awaiting further direction from Wall Street's .DJI opening and Friday's inflationary pressures in the economy.
* Bel-20 .BFX up 0.13 pct, or 2.69 points, at 2,106.98, with a light 2.2 billion francs volume of Belgian shares traded.
* Insurer Royale Belge, the main Bel-20 gainer, up 3.33 percent at 8,700 francs amid renewed investor interes.
